column3: “The south side” is rendered “the right side.”
NASB renders “the gate of the outside” as “the outer gate.”
NASB supplies “cubits” and renders “waters of ankles” as “water reaching the ankles.”
NASB adds “Again” and supplies “reaching.”
“Waters of swimming” is rendered “enough water to swim in.”
NASB adds “this” to “have you seen.”
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew “to the sea, those brought out” is difficult; NASB renders it “being made to flow into the sea,” supplies “of the sea,” and renders “healed” as “become fresh.” The meaning is uncertain.
The Hebrew has “two rivers” (dual), rendered “the river”; NASB supplies “the others” and renders “healed” as “become fresh.”
“The great sea” is rendered “the Great Sea.”
“Healed” is rendered “become fresh”; “given to salt” is rendered “left for salt.”
“Will bear early fruit to its months” is rendered “will bear every month.”
The Hebrew “Joseph, portions” is rendered “Joseph shall have two portions.”
“I lifted up my hand” is rendered “I swore”; “each like his brother” is rendered “each one equally with the other.”
“Lebo Zedad” is rendered “to the entrance of Zedad.”
Close to the Hebrew.
NASB adds “extend” and “This is.”
NASB’s “you shall measure” reflects the Hebrew text; “the north border” supplies “north.”
NASB supplies “of Egypt” with “brook.”
NASB supplies “south” in “south border.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Sojourners” is rendered “aliens,” “fathered children” “bring forth sons,” and “people of Israel” “sons of Israel.”
“Sojourner” is rendered “alien.”
